theses.subject: Banks

The guardrail explicitly warns against treating momentum rank as a buy list, so the honest lean on the strongest name is to avoid adding here — not a fade, not a short, just no new risk concentration into a crowded one-narrative leader.

theses.dissent: In a narrow single-narrative tape, Banks is the only place where the trend gate and durability_bar (0.52) align with rising scores; staying underweight or avoiding it could mean missing the one self-reinforcing flow that continues for a month more. State-owned bank reform or a credit-cycle upswing could extend the run despite crowding.
